STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA
DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATION
GOVERNOR
W. L. TURNER
DIRECTOR
STATE PLANNING DIVISION RONALD F. SCOTT STATE PLANNING OFFICER
REPLY TO:
CLEARINGHOUSE AND INFORMATION CENTER 116 WEST JONES STREET RALEIGH. N. C. 27603 (919) 829-4375
May 19, 1972
Mr. Yates M. Barber, Jr., Acting Chief Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U. S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Barber:
Re: Draft Environmental Statement Proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972
We are enclosing for your information and use in preparing your final environmental statement the comments we have received from North Carolina State agencies relative to the subject draft environmental statement.
The draft statement, dated March 21, 1972, was transmitted to this office by your letter of March 22, 1972.
Sincerely yours,
RANDOLPH HENDRICKS
Planning Coordinator
